قِزْحٌ (IAar, S, Msb, K) and ↓ قَزْحٌ (IAar, K) Seeds that are used in cooking, for seasoning food; syn. تَابَلٌ; (S, K;) or أَبْزَارٌ; (Msb;) that are put into the cooking-pot; such as cuminsees and coriander-seeds: pl. أَقْزَاحٌ: (TA:) and ↓ تَقَازِيحُ (a pl. that has no sing., TA) signifies the same as [أَقْزَاحٌ, i. e.] أَبَازِيرُ. (S, K, TA.) ―
-b2- And the former (قِزْحٌ) signifies also Onion-seed: (K, TA:) so in the dial. of Syria. (TA.) ―
-b3- And The dung of the serpent: (K, TA:) pl. أَقْزَاحٌ, as above. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
